column2:
[title20]BINOCULARS
This is a handy pair of StarTech
"Planetary Explorer" binoculars, adjustable
for 10x through 30x magnification.
column3:
[title20]望遠鏡
這是一副星際科技出品的
「行星探險家」望遠鏡，
倍率可調10到30倍，相當
好用。

column2:
[title15]BURGER
This is a festering mass of congealed
fungus that you knew in former times as a
hamburger.
column3:
[title15]漢堡
這坨發霉凝結的真菌，
你依稀記得它曾經
是個漢堡。

column2:
[title24]DEAD FISH
This is your basic, bloated, dead fish.
Although it is of an alien species, it is
just as disgusting as any dead fish you
have encountered on more familiar worlds.
column3:
[title24]死魚
這是條再普通不過、腫脹
發臭的死魚。雖然是外星
品種，噁心程度跟你在
熟悉世界見過的死魚
不相上下。

column2:
[title26]STUFFED FISH
Apparently the dead fish wasn't disgusting
enough for you, so you have jammed that
festering burger down its throat, with
truly appalling results.
column3:
[title26]塞料死魚
看來死魚還不夠噁心，
於是你把那坨發霉漢堡
硬塞進牠喉嚨，成果
慘不忍睹。

column2:
[title26]REBREATHER
This is an oxygen rebreather you picked up on
Cowplug VIII while you were stranded there
fixing your hyperdrive shunt.  Easily the
classiest way to see the Great Bovine Reefs
up close.
column3:
[title26]水中呼吸器
這是你在牛塞八號星
拋錨修理超空間分流器
時順手撈到的水中呼吸器，
近距離觀賞大牛角礁，
這絕對是最有格調的
方式。

column2:
[title22]TIMER MODULE
This timer module was an integral part of your
ship until you crash landed here.  It still works,
but you probably shouldn't bet your life on it's
accuracy.
column3:
[title22]計時模組
這個計時模組原本是你
太空船的一部分，直到
你墜機在這裡。它還能動，
不過準不準，你可別
拿命去賭。

column2:
[title32]BIG LEAVES
The large green leaves barely fit in your
pockets.  They have strong veins and
look a bit like spinach leaves.
column3:
[title32]大葉子
這幾片綠色大葉子勉強
塞得進口袋，葉脈粗壯，
有點像菠菜葉。

column2:
[title32]POISON DARTS
The tips of these blowgun darts have
been treated with chemical that when
introduced into the bloodstream causes
rapid cranial contractions.
column3:
[title32]毒鏢
這些吹箭鏢的尖端塗有
化學藥劑，一旦進入
血液，會讓頭顱急速
收縮。

column2:
[title32]PLANT STALK
This plant stalk has been lying on the ground
for a while.  The center has rotted out, leaving
a long round tube-like outer shell.
column3:
[title32]植物莖
這根植物莖已經在地上
躺了一陣子，中心早已
腐爛，只剩下一根
中空的長條外殼。

column2: [title32]BLOWGUN\nThis handy little blowgun is the perfect\ntool for propelling darts toward a target.
column3:
[title32]吹箭筒
這支小巧的吹箭筒，
正是把鏢射向目標的
最佳工具。

column2:
[title32]TWINKIFRUIT
This luscious little fruit looks almost too good
to be organic.  Something this tasty ought to
come in a cellophane wrapper.  It's a safe bet
that this is the tastiest, yummiest, most delicious
snack on the entire island.
column3:
[title32]甜滋果
這顆多汁的小果子好吃
到不像天然食物，這麼
美味的東西應該要用
玻璃紙包裝才對。可以
打包票，這絕對是全島
最好吃的零食。

column2:
[title32]BONE
It's not big enough to be a femur, nor is it
small enough to be a finger.  You're not exactly
sure what kind of bone this is.
column3:
[title32]骨頭
說是大腿骨嫌小，說是
手指骨又嫌大，你也
說不準這到底是哪根
骨頭。

column2: [title32]CHICKEN\nThis juicy, golden-brown, roasted chicken makes\nyour mouth water.
column3: [title32]烤雞\n這隻多汁金黃的烤雞，\n讓你看了直流口水。

column2:
[title32]SCALPEL
This surgical steel scalpel is quite sharp.  It also
appears to be very strong.  You should be careful
with this.
column3:
[title32]手術刀
這把醫療鋼手術刀相當
鋒利，看起來也很堅固，
拿的時候小心點。

column2: [title32]AUDIO TAPE\nThis standard ninety-minute audio tape is light\nand compact.
column3: [title32]錄音帶\n這捲標準九十分鐘錄音帶，\n輕巧好攜帶。

column2:
[title32]CREDIT CHIP
This looks like an honest-to-goodness credit
chip!  If you started paying all your bills you
could probably qualify for one of these--in about 20 years.
column3:
[title32]信用晶片
這看起來是張如假包換的
信用晶片！要是你開始
乖乖繳帳單，大概再過
二十年就能申請到一張。

column2:
[title32]SECURITY CARD
The woman on the card has a cold stare.  You take
comfort in the fact that she's monster food now.  The
security card has a small magnetic strip on it.
column3:
[title32]保全卡
卡片上的女人眼神冷冽，
不過想到她現在已經是
怪物的食物，你就稍微
安心了點。卡片上有條
小磁條。

column2:
[title32]CHARGE CASES
These military compression cases are normally
used to contain explosive charges.  In their
current state of emptiness they are about as
dangerous as coffee cans.
column3:
[title32]裝藥盒
這種軍規壓縮盒平常是
用來裝炸藥的，現在
空空如也，危險程度
大概跟咖啡罐差不多。

column2: [title32]<Deleted: Estrotoxin>\nOne day, this object will have a name.
column3: [title32]<Deleted： Estrotoxin>\n總有一天，這個物件\n會有個名字。

column2: [title32]BOMB\nThe detonator on this bomb looks sensitive.\nYou should be careful that you don't drop it.
column3:
[title32]炸彈
這顆炸彈的引爆器看起來
很敏感，千萬別手滑
摔到它。

column2: [title32]TIME BOMB\nBy wiring your old timer module to the detonator\non this baby you have created a makeshift time bomb.
column3:
[title32]定時炸彈
把舊計時模組接上這寶貝
的引爆器，你就湊出了一顆
克難定時炸彈。

column2: [title32]REPAIR LIST\nRight now you SHOULD be reading it.
column3: [title32]維修清單\n你現在「應該」要讀的\n就是這個。

column2:
[title32]ALIEN LIQUOR
This looks like punchy stuff.  You never know what
to expect with booze from other planets.  From the
clarity of the liquor, you assume it to be about 195
proof.
column3:
[title32]外星烈酒
這玩意兒後座力十足，
外星酒你永遠猜不透。
看這酒色的清澈程度，
你猜大概有195度。

column2:
[title32]TARGET MODULE
The quality of the target module impresses you.  With
this thing running a small ship's fire control computer,
you would be able to hit almost anything--hard and fast.
column3:
[title32]瞄準模組
這個瞄準模組的品質讓你
印象深刻。裝上小型太空船
的射控電腦，幾乎什麼
目標都能又快又準地
命中。

column2:
[title21]SHIELD MODULATOR
This type of shield modulator can increase the performance
of defensive screens by rapidly diverting power to the
point of impact.  Without one of these on the Pig,
you probably wouldn't be alive right now.
column3:
[title21]護盾調變器
這種護盾調變器能把能量
快速引導到受擊點，藉此
提升防禦力場的效能。
「油豬號」要是沒裝這個，
你現在大概已經不在
人世了。

column2:
[title32]TAPE PLAYER
This state-of-the-art stereophonic tape player features
long-throw titanium-cone woofers, a 26-band tuner which
includes those hard to find bands such as gamma and graviton wave,
and a built-in atomic power plant that renders batteries
obsolete.
column3:
[title32]錄音機
這台最先進的立體聲錄音機
配備長衝程鈦振膜低音喇叭、
26波段調諧器（連珈瑪波、
重力波這種冷門波段都收得到）
還內建原子動力爐，電池
什麼的早就過時了。

column2: [title32]PHONE CELLS\nThese look like standard double-Q sized batteries,
column3: [title32]電話電池\n這看起來是標準雙Q號\n電池，

column2:
[title32]PENLIGHT
This hand-held penlight would be convenient if
it weren't quite so large.  They must have big
pens on this planet.
column3:
[title32]筆型手電筒
這支手持筆型手電筒要是
沒那麼大支，會方便
不少。看來這星球的筆
都特別粗。

column2:
[title32]"DURAFAIL" CELLS
This pair of double-Q batteries bear the
"only name to trust your battery needs to."
Right.
column3:
[title32]「勁掛」電池
這對雙Q號電池自稱是
「唯一能信任你電力
需求的品牌」。是喔。

column2:
[title32]FAKE ID CARD
The quality of this ID appalls you.  That
it may actually work around here strikes you
as nothing less than miraculous.
column3:
[title32]假證件
這張證件的做工爛到讓你
傻眼，如果在這裡真的
能矇混過關，那簡直
是奇蹟。

column2: [title32]ID CARD\nNow this is a decent ID.  It appears that\nBuck had a decent security clearance too.
column3:
[title32]證件
這張證件像樣多了。看來
巴克的保全權限等級
也不差。

column2:
[title32]POLYCEMENT
This fast-drying all-purpose cement can be
used to repair broken plates, broken auto body panels,
broken teeth, and possibly broken marriages.
column3:
[title32]強力膠
這罐快乾萬能膠水能修
破盤子、修烤漆掉了的
車身板件、修斷牙，
搞不好還能修婚姻。

column2:
[title32]FISHING ROD
This quaint little fishing rod reminds you of
weekends spent fishing with your uncle.
Of course, all you ever caught was the flu.
column3:
[title32]釣竿
這根復古小釣竿讓你想起
跟叔叔一起釣魚的週末。
當然，你每次的漁獲
只有感冒。

column2: [title32]FISHING LINE\nThis is the thin nylon line you removed\nfrom the fishing rod.
column3: [title32]釣魚線\n這是你從釣竿上拆下來\n的細尼龍線。

column2:
[title32]PADLOCK KEY
Manufactured from something vaguely resembling
brass, this key has fared well over the years.
It is heavy for it's size.
column3:
[title32]掛鎖鑰匙
這把鑰匙由某種類似黃銅
的材質製成，歷經歲月
保養得還不錯，以它的
尺寸來說相當沉。

column2: [title32]DOOR KEY\nThis thin door key has the word "Schludge" engraved\non it.
column3: [title32]門鑰匙\n這把薄門鑰匙上刻著\n「史拉奇」幾個字。

column2:
[title32]REARVIEW MIRROR
You lifted this mirror from a
repair shop.  It is too small for a spaceship,
but it could be useful as a shaving mirror.
column3:
[title32]後照鏡
這面鏡子是你從修車廠
順來的。當太空船後照鏡
太小了，不過拿來刮鬍子
倒是剛好。

column2:
[title32]COMPACT
You never expected to find yourself carrying
one of these around.  The blush is a little dark
for you, but the mirror is in good shape.
column3:
[title32]粉餅盒
你從沒想過自己會隨身
帶著這種東西。腮紅色號
對你來說深了點，不過
鏡子倒是完好無缺。

column2: [title32]<Deleted: Magnet>\nOne day, this object will have a name.
column3: [title32]<Deleted： Magnet>\n總有一天，這個物件\n會有個名字。

column2:
[title32]DETONATORS
These are military-grade detonators; they
are extremely sensitive.  An electrical charge
in the right place or a sudden jolt would set
these right off.  The four-prong design ensures proper
ignition of an explosive charge.
column3:
[title32]雷管
這是軍規雷管，極度敏感，
只要通對地方的電，或是
一個突然的震動，就會
立刻引爆。四爪設計能
確保炸藥確實點燃。

column2: [title32]BOTTLE\nThis dirty old bottle had the audacity to be\nfloating around without a message in it.
column3:
[title32]瓶子
這個又髒又舊的瓶子，
裡面竟然沒有夾張紙條，
膽子真大。

column2:
[title32]CHICKEN BOMB
This incendiary fowl is sufficiently
dangerous to warrant great care.  You
may want to stop nibbling off of it now.
column3:
[title32]雞肉炸彈
這隻縱火用的家禽危險性
不容小覷，你最好現在
就別再啃了。

column2:
[title32]VASE
The beautiful lavender vase is worth
a lot of money to you.  After all you
went through to get hold of it you
wouldn't want to drop it.
column3:
[title32]花瓶
這只淡紫色花瓶美得很，
對你來說也值不少錢。
你費了那麼大勁才弄到手，
可千萬別摔了它。

column2:
[title32]REMOTE
This odd-looking remote control has only
one button on it.  It also has a small
inscription on the side: "Please return
to Goldenpipe Space Port".  Hmmm.
column3:
[title32]遙控器
這個造型古怪的遙控器
只有一顆按鈕，側邊還刻著
一行小字：「請歸還黃金管
太空港」。嗯……

column2: [title32]<Deleted: Game>\nOne day, this object will have a name.
column3: [title32]<Deleted： Game>\n總有一天，這個物件\n會有個名字。

column2:
[title32]HANDSET
The telephone handset is small and light,
as you would expect something portable
to be.
column3:
[title32]話筒
這支電話話筒輕巧小巧，
正如你對「可攜式」
這三個字的想像。

column2:
[title32]BONES
They're not big enough to be femurs, nor are they
small enough to be fingers.  You're not exactly
sure what kind of bones these are.
column3:
[title32]骨頭
說是大腿骨嫌小，說是
手指骨又嫌大，你也
說不準這些到底是哪些
骨頭。

column2:
[title32]GUARD'S ARM
Yech!  This arm is starting to get stiff.
You instinctively notice the lack of a
wedding band.
column3:
[title32]守衛的手臂
噁！這隻手臂開始僵硬了。
你下意識注意到，它
沒戴婚戒。

column2:
[title32]Voice-Activated Auto-Transcribing Audio Log
[center]Beezlebody's Novelty Shop
[center]Asteroid 80791-G (orbiting Bageljuice IX)
[center]
[center]Cover: 100% Genuine Leather
column3:
[title32]語音啟動自動謄寫錄音日誌
[center]別西怪玩具店
[center]小行星80791-G
（環繞貝果汁九號星軌道）
[center]
[center]封面材質：100%純皮革

column2: [title32]BOMBS\nThe detonators on these bombs look rather sensitive.\nYou should be careful that you don't drop them.
column3:
[title32]炸彈
這些炸彈的引爆器看起來
相當敏感，千萬別
手滑摔到它們。

column2: [title32]NOTE\nIf you can read this then you should call Brian Reynolds\nat MicroProse Software and tell him you found a bug.
column3:
[title32]紙條
如果你看得懂這行字，
記得打給MicroProse
Software的Brian
Reynolds，跟他說你
抓到一個bug。

column2:
[title32]COMBINATION
Ah ha!  You have a pretty good idea what
this is!  Right, left, right, left, these must be
directions to somewhere in the city.
column3:
[title32]密碼
哈！你大概猜到這是什麼
了！右、左、右、左，
這應該是城裡某個地方
的路線指示。

column2:
[title32]FORMALDEHYDE
You get a whiff of the formaldehyde, and begin
to have an olfactory flashback.  Images of
long-dead frogs flash through your mind.
column3:
[title32]福馬林
你聞到福馬林的味道，
嗅覺瞬間把你拉回過去，
腦海閃過一堆早已
作古的青蛙畫面。

column2: [title32]PETROX\nThis stuff can be used to power spacecraft.\nYou should be VERY careful with it.
column3:
[title32]貝托克斯
這玩意兒能拿來當太空船
燃料，處理時「務必」
非常小心。

column2: [title32]LECITHIN\nHmmm. Phosphatides extracted from\negg-yolk no doubt.
column3: [title32]卵磷脂\n嗯……八成是從蛋黃\n萃取出來的磷脂質。

column2:
[title32]CHARGE CASES
These military compression cases are normally
used to contain explosive charges.  They are
currently full of "Pyro's special".  Remember
what happened to her when she dropped some
of this stuff . . . .
column3:
[title32]裝藥盒
這種軍規壓縮盒平常是
用來裝炸藥的，現在裝滿
了「派羅特調」。記得
她之前失手摔了一些
之後發生了什麼事……

column2:
[title32]HANDSET
The telephone handset is small and light,
as you would expect something portable
to be, particularly with the batteries out.
column3:
[title32]話筒
這支電話話筒輕巧小巧，
正如你對「可攜式」
這三個字的想像，畢竟
電池都被拿掉了。

column2:
[title32]FISHING ROD
This quaint little fishing rod reminds you of
weekends spent fishing with your uncle.
It is not currently of any use, since you
removed the fishing line.
column3:
[title32]釣竿
這根復古小釣竿讓你想起
跟叔叔一起釣魚的週末。
不過現在派不上用場，
因為釣魚線已經被你
拆掉了。

column2:
[title32]BOTTLE
This dirty old bottle had the audacity to be
floating around without a message in it.
The bottle is about one quarter full of water.
column3:
[title32]瓶子
這個又髒又舊的瓶子，
裡面竟然沒有夾張紙條，
膽子真大。瓶裡大概裝了
四分之一瓶水。

column2:
[title32]BOTTLE
This dirty old bottle had the audacity to be
floating around without a message in it.
The bottle is about half full of water.
column3:
[title32]瓶子
這個又髒又舊的瓶子，
裡面竟然沒有夾張紙條，
膽子真大。瓶裡大概裝了
半瓶水。

column2:
[title32]BOTTLE
This dirty old bottle had the audacity to be
floating around without a message in it.
The bottle is about three quarters full of water, which
is starting to make it too heavy to carry around.
column3:
[title32]瓶子
這個又髒又舊的瓶子，
裡面竟然沒有夾張紙條，
膽子真大。瓶裡大概裝了
四分之三瓶水，開始
重得有點難帶著走。

column2:
[title32]BOTTLE
This dirty old bottle had the audacity to be
floating around without a message in it.
The bottle is full of water, which is starting to
make it too heavy to carry around.
column3:
[title32]瓶子
這個又髒又舊的瓶子，
裡面竟然沒有夾張紙條，
膽子真大。瓶裡裝滿了水，
重得開始難帶著走。

column2:
[title32]TAPE PLAYER
This state-of-the-art stereophonic tape player features
long-throw titanium-cone woofers, a 26 band-tuner which
includes those hard to find bands like gamma and graviton wave,
and a built-in atomic power plant that renders batteries
obsolete.  There is a small audio tape in the tape player.
column3:
[title32]錄音機
這台最先進的立體聲錄音機
配備長衝程鈦振膜低音喇叭、
26波段調諧器（連珈瑪波、
重力波這種冷門波段都收得到）
還內建原子動力爐，電池
什麼的早就過時了。錄音機
裡還有一捲小錄音帶。

column2:
[title32]PLAY AUDIO TAPE
You hear a feminine voice dictating:
[center]
"Entry 21 . . . 28 Bicuspidor 90919 . . . Project KABLOOEY . . . Professor
Ihma Pyro reporting.  This batch will be called 'LOT 7'.  It is essentially
LOT 6 with a higher petrox concentration.  I'll start by adding a [index0]
of [index4] . . . O.K., then a [index1] of [index5] and a gentle stir.  That
looks pretty good.  Now the [index6]; just a [index2].  Another gentle stir.
All right.  Finally, a [index3] of [index7].  O.K., this batch looks good.
I am transporting the mixture to the processing bench where I will--OOPS!"
[center]<BLAM!>
[center]
The rest of the tape is silent.
column3:
[title32]播放錄音帶
你聽見一個女性的聲音
正在口述：
[center]
「第21筆紀錄……畢庫斯波多
曆90919年28日……轟毀計畫……
這裡是艾瑪‧派羅教授。這批
就叫『七號批』，基本上是
六號批加高貝托克斯濃度的
版本。我先加一[index0]
[index4]……好，接著加一
[index1][index5]，輕輕攪拌。
看起來不錯。現在加[index6]，
只要一[index2]就好。再輕輕
攪拌一次。好了。最後加一
[index3][index7]。嗯，這批
看起來不錯。我現在要把
混合物搬去處理台，我要——
哎呀！」
[center]〈轟！〉
[center]
錄音帶接下來一片寂靜。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
This computer printout appears to be a list of teleporters and their
maintenance status.  Reading the list you learn that teleporters [number0],
[number1], [number2], and [number3] have been taken off-line pending repairs;
units [number4] and [number5] have been recently tuned; units [number6] and
[number7] are in need of minor adjustments; and that the gender-security
module in unit [number8] is due for scheduled maintenance.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這張電腦報表似乎是傳送
器的維修狀態清單。讀完
之後你得知：[number0]、
[number1]、[number2]、
[number3]號傳送器因待修
而離線；[number4]號和
[number5]號最近才校準過；
[number6]號和[number7]號
需要小幅調整；而
[number8]號的性別安全
模組則排定要進行
例行保養。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You wire the detonators to the explosives
inside the charge cases.  You now have a
fine pair of bombs.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你把雷管接上裝藥盒裡的
炸藥，湊出了一對
像樣的炸彈。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You hook the timer module onto the end
of the bomb, and wire it to the detonator.
This should now function as a crude time
bomb once you activate the timer module.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你把計時模組接到炸彈
尾端，再接上雷管。只要
啟動計時模組，這應該
就能當克難定時炸彈用。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The charge cases currently contain no
explosive material.  Therefore, there is
no point in attaching the detonators.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
裝藥盒裡目前沒有炸藥，
所以接上雷管也是
白搭。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You press the "PLAY" button, but nothing
happens.  Apparently there is no tape
inside.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你按下「播放」鍵，卻
什麼都沒發生，看來
裡面沒有錄音帶。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou press the "EJECT" button, but nothing\nhappens.  Apparently there is no tape inside.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你按下「退出」鍵，卻
什麼都沒發生，看來
裡面沒有錄音帶。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The tape player has no obvious screws
or other latching devices.  You can't
even find a battery slot, so it must
have some permanent internal power source.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這台錄音機看不出有螺絲
或其他卡榫，連電池槽
都找不到，想必內建了
某種永久電源。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You pop open the case and remove the
fishing line cassette.  There is a LOT
of fishing line on this cassette--probably
several hundred yards of micro thin fiber.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你打開機殼，取出釣魚線
捲軸。這捲軸上的釣魚線
多到誇張——大概有
好幾百碼的超細纖維。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou have already removed all of the fishing\nline from this rod.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你已經把這根釣竿上的\n釣魚線全部拆下來了。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You gently stroke the plant stalk a few
times, but nothing happens.  Perhaps you'd
better think of something more productive
to do.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你輕輕撫摸植物莖幾下，
什麼事也沒發生。你或許
該想點更有建設性的
事來做。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You unscrew the cap of the penlight.  Inside,
you find a pair of "DURAFAIL" cells.  There
is no apparent corrosion, but the cells have
completely lost their charge.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你旋開筆型手電筒的蓋子，
裡面是一對「勁掛」電池。
看不出生鏽，不過電力
已經完全耗盡。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You unscrew the cap of the penlight.  Inside,
you find a pair of "DURAFAIL" cells.  This must
be your lucky day, because not only are there
no signs of corrosion, but the cells appear to
be fully charged.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你旋開筆型手電筒的蓋子，
裡面是一對「勁掛」電池。
今天肯定是你的幸運日，
不只沒生鏽，電力看起來
還是滿的。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou unscrew the cap of the penlight and once\nagain remove the "DURAFAIL" cells.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你旋開筆型手電筒的蓋子，\n再次取出「勁掛」電池。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou unscrew the cap of the penlight and\nremove the phone cells that you put there.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你旋開筆型手電筒的蓋子，
取出你先前放進去的
電話電池。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You open the battery slot on the handset and
remove your "DURAFAIL" cells.  Leaving them in
the phone seems to have paid off, because they
each now show a full charge.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你打開話筒的電池槽，
取出「勁掛」電池。放在
電話裡似乎有回報，兩顆
電池現在都顯示滿電。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You open the battery slot on the handset and
remove your "DURAFAIL" cells.  They each still show
a full charge.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你打開話筒的電池槽，
取出「勁掛」電池。兩顆
電池仍然顯示滿電。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You open the battery slot on the handset and
remove your "DURAFAIL" cells.  They are still
uncharged.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你打開話筒的電池槽，
取出「勁掛」電池。
電池依然沒電。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You pry open the battery slot on the handset and
discover two phone cell batteries inside.  The power
source for this phone must still be active, because
it seems to have kept the batteries fully charged.
You pocket the phone cells for future reference.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你撬開話筒的電池槽，發現
裡面有兩顆電話電池。這支
電話的電源想必還通著，
因為電池一直保持滿電。
你把電話電池收進口袋
備用。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You pry open the battery slot on the handset and
once again remove the fully-charged phone cells.
You again pocket them for future reference.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你撬開話筒的電池槽，再次
取出滿電的電話電池，
又把它們收進口袋備用。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou put the phone cells into the penlight, and\nscrew on the cap.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你把電話電池裝進筆型\n手電筒，旋上蓋子。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou cannot put the phone cells into the penlight\nwhile the "DURAFAIL" cells are already inside.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
筆型手電筒裡還裝著
「勁掛」電池，沒辦法
再放進電話電池。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou slip the phone cells back into the handset\nfor safekeeping.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你把電話電池放回話筒裡\n收好。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You cannot put the phone cells back into the
handset, because the "DURAFAIL" cells are currently
inside.
